title: It's a Thicker/Denser Norwex Towel But Without the BacLock Antibacterial Silver
text:
It's a Thicker/Denser Norwex Towel But Without the BacLock Antibacterial Silver. This so-called "bath mat" is just a thicker and denser Norwex microfiber towel made of the exact same 70% Polyester and 30% Polyamide as the Norwex bath towels.

The Norwex bath towels, however, also have what Norwex calls "BacLock" (which they say is silver that makes the towels antibacterial). But for some reason, Norwex decided not to put this same BacLock in what they're selling as bath mats, even though the bath mats are as expensive as the larger bath towels. I find this to be unacceptable and quite disappointing.

Who wouldn't want the Norwex bath mats to be as antibacterial as the Norwex towels? I certainly would.

Norwex's big selling point for their towel products is that they are antibacterial with the addition of what they are calling "BacLock" (you'll see the word "BacLock" on the tag sewed into the towels). I expected this microfiber bath mat to include the BacLock since it's made from the same exact 70% Polyester and 30% Polyamide material.

This so-called bath mat is soft and it does absorb water well. I would have given it 5 stars had it contained the Norwex BacLock.

This bath mat is absolutely not worth the $38 I paid for it since it does not include the Norwex BacLock silver antibacterial protection.
